description: Fix T4 RAM crash by skipping LTXDirector (and its CLIP loading) in t4_safe mode, deferring VAE loading until needed, and ensuring sequential model loading pattern.
steps: Step 1 - In build_director_conditioning, add early return to fallback when QUALITY_MODE == 't4_safe' to skip CLIP loading entirely

Step 2 - In generate_chunk, defer video_vae and audio_vae loading from step 2 (before director conditioning) to step 6 (before Director Guide pass 1) since they are not needed until then in the fallback path
Step 3 - In _build_director_fallback, accept video_vae as optional parameter so it can be loaded externally and passed in (avoiding double load)
Step 4 - Add a T4_PROFILES skip_director flag and use it to control Director skip behavior
acceptance_criteria: Python file passes py_compile and ast.parse without errors
When QUALITY_MODE is t4_safe, build_director_conditioning skips CLIP loading and goes straight to fallback
Video VAE is loaded only when needed (before Director Guide, not at the top of generate_chunk)
Audio VAE loading is deferred until build_director_conditioning fallback or decode time
The pipeline still works correctly when not in t4_safe mode
findings: Implemented successfully. In t4_safe mode: (1) LTXDirector is bypassed entirely via skip_director profile flag, preventing CLIP (Gemma 3 12B ~6GB) from loading alongside DiT+LoRAs. (2) Video VAE loading deferred from step 2 to step 6/7 (when actually needed), reducing peak memory by ~1GB during the critical DiT+LoRA load phase. (3) Fallback path still loads DiT+4LoRAs and audio_vae (small), producing standard conditioning. The pipeline retains full Director functionality when not in t4_safe mode.
